net sales.heading: Revenue recognition
net sales.text: Application of the accounting principles in U.S. GAAP related to the measurement and recognition of revenue requires us to make judgments and estimates. Complex agreements with nonstandard terms and conditions may require interpretation to determine the appropriate accounting. Specifically, the determination of whether we are a principal to a transaction or an agent can also require considerable judgment. We have concluded that in nearly all cases we are the principal in our payment processing agreements as we control the service on our payments platform, which is transformative in nature and allows for front-end and back-end risk mitigation, merchant portability, third-party software integrations, and enhanced reporting functionality. We also contract directly with our merchants and have complete pricing latitude on the processing fees charged to our merchants. As such, we bear the credit risk for network fees and transactions. For our SaaS agreements, we allocate revenue to each performance obligation based on its relative standalone selling price, which is based on the estimated fair value of each product and service. Changes in judgments with respect to these assumptions and estimates could impact the amount of revenue recognized.

net sales.heading: Revenue recognition
net sales.text: Application of the accounting principles in U.S. GAAP related to the measurement and recognition of revenue requires us to make judgments and estimates. Complex agreements with nonstandard terms and conditions may require interpretation to determine the appropriate accounting. Specifically, the determination of whether we are a principal to a transaction or an agent can also require considerable judgment. We have concluded that in nearly all cases we are the principal in our payment processing agreements as we control the service on our payments platform, which is transformative in nature and allows for front-end and back-end risk mitigation, merchant portability, third-party software integrations, and enhanced reporting functionality. We also contract directly with our merchants and have complete pricing latitude on the processing fees charged to our merchants. As such, we bear the credit risk for network fees and transactions. For our SaaS agreements, we allocate revenue to each performance obligation based on its relative standalone selling price, which is based on the estimated fair value of each product and service. Changes in judgments with respect to these assumptions and estimates could impact the amount of revenue recognized.

lines.why: Bonds, notes and loans: financial.

lines.name: Operating lease liabilities
lines.why: Rent owed on leases used in the business: operating by default. Move it to financing to treat leases like debt (if the balance sheet has no lease line of its own, they sit inside other liabilities).

lines.name: Deferred tax liabilities
lines.why: Taxes on operating income deferred: operating.

lines.name: Deferred revenue, non-current
lines.why: Customers' payments for later years: operating.

lines.name: Other non-current liabilities
lines.why: Other long-term operating obligations: operating.

lines.name: Other assets, not tagged separately
lines.why: Total assets minus the lines above: assets the company tags its own way. Operating by default.

lines.name: Other liabilities, not tagged separately
lines.why: Total liabilities minus the lines above: liabilities the company tags its own way. Operating by default.
